description: [Merchant] Get download URL for logs archive. Premium plan required. Returns URL for downloading logs as gzipped JSON file.

from.description: Start timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z'). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses environment-specific private key as default.

to.description: End timestamp in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T23:59:59Z'). Defaults to now.

name: payware_logs_download_url
